data.narrative:
Nano Nuclear Energy, founded by Jay Jiang Yu, is a Seed-stage nuclear energy company with a current post-money valuation of $808M and cumulative capital raised exceeding $600M. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 11 entities across the nuclear energy sector: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Oklo, X-Energy, Fuse Energy, Applied Atomics, and Exodys Energy.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method here. Beginning from the $808M last post-money valuation, applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier for progression from Seed to the next development stage yields an implied valuation of $2.0B. Peer-median benchmarking cannot be reliably applied; while three nuclear energy peers exist in the reference universe, insufficient density of same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables (fewer than three datapoints in any narrow filter) makes sector-wide median analysis uninformative rather than illuminating.

The triangulated valuation range supported by applicable methods is $1.7B (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median point of $2.0B. This single-method result carries meaningful uncertainty: the narrow peer set precludes robust cross-validation, and stage-progression relies on the assumption that standard multipliers apply to frontier nuclear technology at seed scale. Key uncertainties include the actual trajectory of capital rounds in this emerging subsector and whether public comps adequately reflect developmental risk.
